result.summary: Re-gate of Step 2b for a lockfile-only fix (commit 5a56bad) applied after RELEASE-VALIDATOR's PASS, once opening PR #55 revealed CI failing with 'Cannot find module @rolldown/binding-wasm32-wasi' -- npm/cli#4828, a plain Windows `npm install` had pruned nearly all platform-variant optional-dependency entries from package-lock.json (esbuild/rolldown/lightningcss native bindings) when the new qrcode/jsqr/pngjs deps were added, leaving the Linux CI runner's package-lock.json blind to the bindings it needs. Scope check (git show --stat 5a56bad): exactly 2 files changed -- package-lock.json (+1044/-24 in the raw diff stat over the parent commit be5944c; against master the requirement's own cumulative lockfile diff is +311 net) and handoffs/WF02-REQ-024/step-02-backend-dev-rework1.json (the bookkeeping record of the fix). Read the full diff (`git diff 5a56bad~1..5a56bad -- package-lock.json`): every changed block is either (a) a platform-specific optional-dependency entry for @esbuild/*, @rolldown/binding-*, or lightningcss.* being restored, or (b) housekeeping dedup noise from the fresh install. No application code touched by this commit -- confirmed apps/bot/src/** and apps/web/src/** are absent from `git show 5a56bad --stat` entirely, and separately confirmed via `git diff master...HEAD -- apps/bot/src apps/web/src` (the whole requirement's cumulative diff) that the only files under those trees are the ones already reviewed and PASSed at the original Step 2b/2c: domain/qr.ts(+test), domain/registration.ts, handlers/my.ts(+test), handlers/registration.ts, i18n/{en,ru,types}.ts, index.ts -- none of which changed again in 5a56bad. Platform-entry-count restoration verified independently, not trusted from the commit message: counted `@esbuild/` occurrences (26), `@rolldown/binding-` occurrences (15), and `lightningcss` occurrences (12) in the current branch's package-lock.json, then checked out master's package-lock.json via `git show master:package-lock.json` and counted the same three patterns there: 26/15/12 -- identical across all three counts. The claimed restoration is real, not an approximation. Ran the full verification chain myself from a clean state: `npm ci` (the exact command CI runs) -- succeeded cleanly, 590 packages added, 0 vulnerabilities, no missing-binding errors. `npm run lint` -- exit 0, 0 errors (2 pre-existing apps/web LCP warnings only, unrelated and unchanged). `npm run build` -- exit 0, both workspaces clean (Next.js Turbopack build succeeded; apps/bot's tsc -p tsconfig.json clean). `npx vitest run --no-file-parallelism` -- 19 files, 171 passed, 46 skipped, 0 failed -- matches BACKEND-DEV's reported figures exactly. No new npm workspace, no apps/* rename, no build-output directory moved by this commit -- it only restores lockfile entries and adds the already-reviewed qrcode/jsqr/pngjs transitive deps. Per my role file's trigger condition, no scratch `docker build -t .` is required for this re-gate. SECURITY-REVIEWER, TEST-DESIGNER, TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR, TEST-RUNNER, and RELEASE-VALIDATOR's prior PASSes were all against the application code, which this commit does not touch at all -- their findings stand unweakened. This re-gate exists solely to confirm the lockfile fix is genuinely infrastructure-only and that the test suite still runs green end to end from a clean install, matching what CI now reports.
